---
name: Contract
about: Draft the contract for one component, for a person to approve
labels: contract
---

## Component

Name and path, for example `section/selector` and `contracts/section/selector/`.

## Inputs

Links to the ADRs, architecture docs, and examples the contract is drawn from. Link, do not copy.

## Done when

- [ ] All four parts exist: behavior description, fixtures, contract tests, interface binding
- [ ] Each fixture cites its source
- [ ] A few plausible wrong implementations were listed, and the tests fail each one
- [ ] The component is not built in this change
- [ ] A person read and approved it

## Out of scope
